title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Twenty Million Pesos to Implement Republic Act Numbered Eight Hundred Ninety-Nine Which Created a Revolving Fund for the Construction, Reconstruction or Improvement of Irrigation Systems
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Twenty Million Pesos to Implement Republic Act Numbered Eight Hundred Ninety-Nine Which Created a Revolving Fund for the Construction, Reconstruction or Improvement of Irrigation Systems

text.en: The sum of twenty million pesos is hereby appropriated, from the amount authorized under Republic Act Numbered One thousand or any other Act of similar nature, which shall constitute the revolving fund created under Republic Act Numbered Eight hundred ninety-nine, for the construction, reconstruction or improvement of irrigation systems as approved by the National Economic Council and in accordance with the provisions of said Republic Act Numbered Eight hundred ninety-nine.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: September 8, 1955.
